metadata.purpose: Track current-public-source freshness without converting an unverified publication gap into a zero or an assertion that no source exists.

status_semantics.verified_current: A public source covering the latest completed relevant period was verified and is already represented in HalifaxData.
status_semantics.verified_new_source: A newer authoritative public source was verified and requires ingestion or integration.
status_semantics.not_yet_verified: Targeted research did not verify a newer source. This is not proof that the source does not exist or will not be published.
status_semantics.current_source_research: The domain source discovery itself was refreshed on the research date; publication/approval timing still governs record availability.
